about: #7353 KRX-TS dependency bundles: items that only work together and so open or hold as one. A member is a file and an item label (`fn reserve_body > stmt CLAIMS`, never a line number) with the cfg it carries; a member whose cfg drifted holds the bundle. Class A only (static, field, variant, impl, initialiser, record statement, consuming branch). Class B (needs an excluded or #[test] module, a not(test) twin, a fixture split) is held through test_support_exclude.json and opened by hand.

bundles.name: claims_judged
bundles.why: claims_judged reads CLAIMS, which only the gated record in reserve_body fills (Sol review krxts-1 P1); opening the reader alone builds but records nothing
